'''Legal Maxims''' — the "Maxims, axioms & idioms" page on [[SoapBox Law]], published at law.soapbox.community/maxims — is a browsable collection of legal maxims, political axioms, and the idioms that carry them into everyday argument.

== What it does ==
Each entry gives a plain-English gloss and where the maxim comes from. The editorial rule is deliberately narrow: the page states what a maxim '''means''' and '''where it is from''' — it does not tell a reader the maxim is correct or that it decides a case.

The legal maxims cross-reference the same subject categories as the [[SoapBox Law]] case law, so a reader can move from a maxim to the decisions that actually apply the principle.
